warning: Public fictional assets and synthetic financials. Software demonstration only; no private Far East portfolio data are included.

methodology.prediction_inputs: Observable underwriting only; no latent simulation truth
methodology.risk_source: Assumed shared economic and cost Student-t(6) factors, idiosyncratic shocks, approval branches
methodology.evaluation_source: Separate random seed plus hidden simulation effects; one outcome per action/environment
methodology.tail_bounds: Student-t outcomes are unbounded and illustrate incremental-NPV model risk; not legal liability bounds
methodology.hold_baseline: Incremental Hold NPV and risk are zero; retained asset value remains in baseline PV
methodology.context_coverage: Populated fields, not verification; legacy real_context_pct is a compatibility alias

environments.label: Base conditions
environments.description: Normal rent, financing, approval and construction conditions.

environments.label: Market and cost stress
environments.description: Rent and occupancy pressure, higher cap rates, construction inflation and slower approvals.

environments.label: Structural demand change
environments.description: Changing occupier demand, competing supply and selective redevelopment or repurposing opportunities.
